title: “Oops, Did I Just Say That?” Testing and Repairing Unethical Suggestions of Large Language Models with Suggest-Critique-Reflect Process
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to benchmarking and improving the 'ethicality' of LLM suggestions. It introduces 'ETHICSSUITE', a test suite comprising 20,000 contextualized moral scenarios used to evaluate how well LLMs align with human values and avoid providing unethical advice.
